reason: The wet methane needs conditioning and storage, so I will start at its dedicated liquefier.
expectation: I expect it to dry and cool the methane for storage, though I am unsure whether drying is a separate step.

alternatives.reason: Oxygen also needs cold storage, but I want to handle the explicitly wet stream first.

effect: The methane liquefier produced the dry, cold store in one action; oxygen remains.
reaction: The result is clear, though I am curious how the water was removed.
reason: Oxygen needs its own store, and its liquefier is the only remaining combination.
expectation: I expect a separate liquid oxygen store and completion of the second goal.

effect: The oxygen liquefier completed the separate store and the chapter.
reaction: The parallel result is clear but unsurprising.

mostWorthwhile.text: Storing the methane connected the earlier fuel-making process to the return trip, although I wanted more detail on drying it.

leastWorthwhile.text: The oxygen action felt repetitive: it mirrored the methane action and added no explanation beyond the completed store.

surprise.text: I expected the methane to be cooled, but was unsure whether drying would be a separate step; the single action satisfied both requirements without explaining the drying.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary because each gas had its named liquefier, though the processing inside was opaque.

continue.text: I would probably continue for the wider story and the prospect of discovering more, but this chapter by itself offered little decision-making or explanation beyond matching each gas to its machine.
